description: This file defines the Pagination class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It provides functionality to generate pagination links for the admin interface based on the provided settings such as total items, current page, and URL. The class encapsulates methods to compute page links, previous/next navigation, and renders a view with pagination controls.
